name: TrustDemoDT02
title: TD.DT.02 Which national schedule code does an imported dose carry?
description: For one dose, decide whether and how the national schedule code is added beside the issuer's product code, which is always kept. Requirements: STD-SEM-001. Hit policy FIRST: the rules are tried in order and the first that matches applies.

action.title: Rule 1
action.description: When outcome is one of reported-unverified, rejected, not-read: mappingBasis = not-imported; action = No schedule code is added. Only a verified dose is imported and mapped (J3's yes path); a reported dose keeps the issuer's code alone.

action.title: Rule 2
action.description: When outcome is verified and mapEntry is equivalent: mappingBasis = concept-map; action = Add the mapped schedule code beside the product code. STD-SEM-001 (map): the published national map has an equivalent; both codings are kept, as in TrustDemoJ3Bcg.

action.title: Rule 3
action.description: When outcome is verified and mapEntry is none and clinicianConfirms is yes: mappingBasis = clinician-confirmed; action = Add the confirmed schedule code beside the product code; record the clinician's attestation as a Provenance; add the pair to the national map. The map has no entry and the clinician confirms the equivalent (J3: the Hep B product). Her decision is recorded and added to the map so the next clinic need not repeat it.

action.title: Rule 4
action.description: When outcome is verified and mapEntry is none and clinicianConfirms is no: mappingBasis = unmapped; action = Keep the product code as it is and show the dose to the clinician as unmapped; the schedule does not count it (TD.DT.03). STD-SEM-001 (unmapped): no equivalent is known, and none is guessed.
